name: LIFTOFF
tagline: Only knows one direction and it's up.
description: A tall, narrow cartoon rocket standing upright, drawn in black outline on a cream page with no fill. Its pointed nose cone ends in one thin needle-like spike at the very top, and a single horizontal line across the body separates the cone from the fuselage. The fuselage is a long tube, slightly wider at the bottom. On the upper left of the body is a small flag: a tiny black-outlined square (the canton) at its top-left, and scribbled horizontal stripes in red and blue beside and below it. Two swept fins stick out near the bottom, one on each side; the right fin is a little larger and hangs lower than the left. The flat bottom edge is slightly tilted. Below it pours a tall column of red exhaust flame in wavy tongues with an orange core, longer than a third of the rocket's height.
card: ATTACK  Stab with the pointy nose
SPECIAL  Hold to fly, flame burns behind
GRAB  Hug with fins, blast off, fling
